newsitem.title: UK: SGB rises to premium on stock market debut.
newsitem.headline: SGB rises to premium on stock market debut.

text.p: Shares in scaffolding company SGB Group Plc on Wednesday rose to a four percent premium on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange.
SGB shares, issued at 150p, gained 6p to 156p by 0935 GMT in volume of 2.6 million shares.
SGB was demerged from UK construction group John Mowlem and Co Plc with Mowlem retaining a 51 percent stake in the company.
Mowlem said the flotation would enhance SGB's growth potential by giving it direct access to capital markets.
SGB supplies scaffolding and access services with operations in Britain, continental Europe, North America, the Middle East and the Asia-Pacific region.
The company employs around 4,000 people and reported pre-tax profits of 13.9 million stg last year.
